states.name: out_reg
states.meaning: Per-bit sticky flag: set to 1 when the corresponding input bit transitions from 1 to 0; held at 1 until synchronous reset.

rules.condition: reset == 0 && (prev_in & ~in) != 0, where prev_in is the in value sampled on the immediately preceding posedge clk including reset cycles (see R4)
rules.spec_quote: capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next
the output will remain 1 until the register is reset

rules.condition: prev_in is updated from the sampled in value on every posedge clk, including cycles where reset == 1; falling-edge detection in R2 uses this prev_in regardless of reset history
rules.spec_quote: capture when the input signal changes from 1 in one clock cycle to 0 the next

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: cycle after reset deasserts at a posedge clk

mid: Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.

uncertain.note: Spec does not state whether prev_in is updated during reset cycles; R4 asserts it is, but an equally plausible reading clears or reinitializes prev_in on reset release so edges spanning reset are not captured.
candidates: prev_in updates on every posedge clk including reset cycles, so a 1-to-0 transition spanning a reset cycle is captured after reset deasserts
prev_in is not updated during reset cycles (or is reinitialized to the current in value on reset release), so a 1-to-0 transition spanning a reset cycle is not captured after reset deasserts

uncertain.note: Spec does not state whether capture is visible same cycle as the falling edge or one cycle later; R2 declares same_cycle, but a registered sticky flag could be next_cycle.
candidates: out is set combinationally in the same cycle the 1-to-0 transition is sampled (same_cycle visibility)
out is registered and reflects the falling-edge capture one clock cycle after the 1-to-0 transition is sampled (next_cycle visibility)

R4_prev_in_tracks_all_cycles: prev_in updates on every posedge clk including reset cycles, so a 1-to-0 transition spanning a reset cycle is captured after reset deasserts
prev_in is not updated during reset cycles (or is reinitialized to the current in value on reset release), so a 1-to-0 transition spanning a reset cycle is not captured after reset deasserts
R2_capture_falling_edge: out is set combinationally in the same cycle the 1-to-0 transition is sampled (same_cycle visibility)
out is registered and reflects the falling-edge capture one clock cycle after the 1-to-0 transition is sampled (next_cycle visibility)
